summary: Validated the deployment-regression fix (dotenv override / CORS). Backend pytest suite of 6 targeted tests all pass: (1) load_dotenv default (override=False) preserves an externally injected MONGO_URL and CORS_ORIGINS; (2) server.py source contains no 'override=True'; (3) /api/ reachable via preview URL (status < 500); (4) CORS preflight from production-like Origin returns 200/204 with allow-origin=* (matches CORS_ORIGINS='*'); (5) admin login (9999999999/Admin@123) returns 200 with session cookie and admin role; (6) employee login (Raj Mehta +91 98765 42100/RajSecure@2026) returns 200 with employee role. Frontend smoke: admin login flow works end-to-end, dashboard 'Collection overview' renders with 23 vendors/employees and live register.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] / os.environ['DB_NAME'] which will raise KeyError with an unhelpful traceback if unset in deployment. Consider a clearer startup-time error message.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is inconsistent per CORS spec - browsers will refuse credentialed requests when Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*'. For preview it works because Starlette echoes '*', but for real production credentialed flows, pin explicit origins.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment regression validated. load_dotenv is called without override so K8s-injected MONGO_URL is preserved. Backend CORS uses env-driven CORS_ORIGINS split by ','. Regression test file at /app/backend/tests/test_deployment_config.py can be reused as a lightweight smoke suite in future iterations.
rca of the issue: Original bug: backend/server.py previously used load_dotenv(..., override=True), which caused the local backend/.env value MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 to overwrite the Kubernetes-injected production MONGO_URL, producing pymongo ServerSelectionTimeoutError during seed_database startup. Fix: removed override flag so load_dotenv respects existing process env (verified via test_dotenv_does_not_override_existing_env and grep on server.py source). CORS also broadened via env-driven CORS_ORIGINS. All preview flows continue to work.
